title: Brown Wildloom Heavyweight Hoodie
description: Crafted from 500GSM ultra-heavyweight loopback organic cotton. Features custom 'Wildloom' graphic embroidery across the chest, double-lined drop-shoulder hood without drawstrings, and kangaroo pouch pocket. Relaxed unisex fit. Pre-shrunk and soft-washed for the ultimate premium feel.
care: Machine wash cold inside out with similar colors. Do not bleach. Hang dry in shade. Iron medium heat inside out. Do not iron directly on print/embroidery.

title: Racing Club Leather Bomber Jacket
description: Constructed from premium full-grain nappa leather. Adorned with custom racing club chenille patches on the chest, sleeves, and back. Finished with heavy metal zip closure, button-snap collar, and ribbed cuffs and hem. Interior features satin lining with dual utility pockets.
care: Professional dry clean by leather specialist only. Do not wash. Do not iron.

title: Basics Oversized Tee - Off White
description: A daily wardrobe essential. Built from 260GSM heavy combed cotton jersey. Cut in a boxy, oversized silhouette with wide sleeves and a thick mock-neck rib collar. Minimalist embroidered logo on the back yoke.
care: Wash inside out with cold water. Use mild detergent. Dry flat in shade to prevent stretching. Warm iron if needed.

title: Yacht Club Striped Resort Shirt
description: Lightweight linen-tencel blend shirt featuring wide vertical resort stripes. Classic camp collar, relaxed button-down front, and chest pocket. Designed for breathable warm-weather luxury.
care: Hand wash or gentle machine wash cold. Do not tumble dry. Line dry. Light steam iron.

title: Polo Club Knitted Ribbed Polo
description: Knitted from premium long-staple cotton yarn in a custom vertical rib texture. Standard collar with a buttonless open placket. Features short sleeves, ribbed bands, and a tailored yet relaxed drape.
care: Hand wash cold. Lay flat to dry on a towel. Do not wring. Store folded, do not hang as it may warp the knit shape.

title: Signature Varsity Jacket - Cobalt
description: Classic collegiate varsity styling. Featuring a heavy wool-blend body and full-grain leather sleeves. Embroidered artwork on chest and large signature back chenille graphic. Quilted satin lining for cold-weather comfort.
care: Dry clean only. Store in a cool, dry garment bag.

title: Racing Team Cap - Emerald Green
description: Unstructured 6-panel strapback cap made from premium cotton twill. Detailed with 3D embroidery of the Racing Club insignia on front and brand text on the rear arch. Adjustable metal buckle closure.
care: Hand wash with cold water and mild soap. Shape and air dry.

title: Classic Utility Cargo Pants - Charcoal
description: Heavyweight cotton canvas cargo pants. Features 8 pockets, adjustable drawstring cuffs at the ankles to toggle fit, custom branded hardware, and a semi-relaxed leg width.
care: Machine wash cold inside out. Tumble dry low. Warm iron if necessary.

title: Acid Wash Denim Case - iPhone 15 Pro
description: Premium protective snap-on iPhone case wrapped in real acid-washed denim fabric. Features raised edges for camera and screen protection, and embossed brand logo on the inner microfiber lining.
care: Wipe with a slightly damp cloth. Avoid submerging in water or contact with oil.

title: Carbon Fiber Protective Case
description: Real matte carbon fiber weave hybrid case. MagSafe compatible, shockproof bumpers, and an ultra-thin tactile feel.
care: Wipe clean with a microfiber cloth.

title: Heavyweight Knit Beanie - Vintage Black
description: Double-layered wool blend ribbed beanie. Wide foldover cuff with woven brand label stitch.

title: Retro Racing Tee - Bright Orange
description: Inspired by vintage motorsport graphics. Heavyweight 280GSM cotton featuring dynamic puff-printed graphics across chest and sleeves. Pre-shrunk for an optimal streetwear fit.
care: Wash cold inside out. Gentle cycle. Do not tumble dry. Do not iron prints.

title: Premium Linen Casual Shirt - Sand
description: 100% pure organic linen casual shirt. Soft-washed for an effortless relaxed texture. Features a classic collar, clean front buttons, and rounded cuffs.
care: Machine wash cold gentle. Iron warm with steam while slightly damp. Hang dry.

title: Loopback Winter Hoodie - Cobalt Blue
description: 450GSM loopback cotton hoodie in an electric cobalt blue dye. Features minimal tone-on-tone embroidery, double-lined hood, and standard fit cuffs.
care: Wash cold inside out. Air dry in shade.

title: Polo Club Knitted Polo - Burgundy
description: Fine-knit breathable cotton polo shirt. Contrasting collar trims, ribbed sleeve hems, and a vintage three-button closure.
care: Hand wash cold. Lay flat to dry.

title: Signature Box Logo Tee - Charcoal
description: Clean and understated. Heavyweight 260GSM combed cotton jersey with our high-density signature box print across the front.
care: Wash inside out cold. Dry in shade.

title: Classic Utility Cargo Pants - Olive
description: Premium olive utility cargos. Multi-pocket design, pre-shrunk soft cotton canvas. Heavy duty stitching, sharp details.
